title: #053. Resource-Constrained Shortest Path (RCSP)
subtitle: Select a minimum-cost s-to-t path using binary flow-conservation arcs subject to a cumulative resource budget.

judge.m0: Output must be an object { selected, totalCost }.
judge.m2: Unit s-t flow conservation failed at node {p0}: net outflow is {p1}, expected {p2}.
judge.m3: Selected arcs do not form a single simple s-to-t path (disconnected cycle or branch detected).
judge.m5: Reported totalCost ({p0}) does not match sum of selected arc costs ({p1}).
judge.m6: Valid s-to-t path within resource limit, but totalCost ({p0}) exceeds minimum ({p1}).
